title: Aureline M5 ready-for-review handoff sheet
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a ready-for-review handoff sheet. Names the object class, its change-intent association, the handoff destination, the validation evidence backing the handoff, the publish-later fallback, and the local-versus-provider commit state — so a local handoff packet or queued publish never masquerades as a provider-committed update. Downstream the ready-for-review handoff, review detail, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a handoff by hand. Secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
